messages.content: Hi, my internet is not working. I can't load any website.
Hello! I'm sorry to hear that. Let me check your account. Could you please confirm your name?
Nandini Bhat.
Thank you, Nandini. I can see your account. Let me check if there are any outages in your area first.
Agent checked outage dashboard - no outages in Malleshwaram area.
No outages detected in your area. Could you try restarting your router? Unplug it, wait 30 seconds, then plug it back in.
OK I did it. Still not working.
What color is the internet light on your router?
It's blinking amber.
Hi, my internet has been down since yesterday evening. I already restarted the router twice. Also my bill is higher this month than usual.
I'm sorry to hear that, Mr. Kulkarni. Let me check your account right away.
My bill was ₹899 last month. Now it shows ₹1199. Nobody told me about an increase.
I can see your account shows FiberMax 200 plan. Let me review the billing details and check on the connectivity issue.
This is very frustrating. I work from home and I need internet. Also I want to understand why my bill increased.
My bill suddenly doubled. I'm on FiberMax 200 plan at ₹899 per month. But now I got a bill for ₹1499.
Hello Ananya. Let me check your account details.
I never requested any plan change. My plan is the 200 Mbps plan. I've been on it for 2 years.
I can see your account. I want to verify — what plan do you believe you are currently on?
FiberMax 200. 200 Mbps. ₹899 per month. That's what I've always been on.
Hi, can you tell me what the weather will be like tomorrow in Mumbai?
Hello! I'm a support specialist for broadband and mobile services. Could you help me understand what you need support with today?
I just want to know the weather. It's going to rain tomorrow right? My outdoor plans depend on it.
My internet is completely dead since I got back from my trip. I've been away for two weeks.
I understand. Have you tried restarting the router?
Yes! I've done that twice already. The router shows a red internet light.
I see. Let me check if all physical connections are secure. Is the cable going into the wall firmly connected?
Yes everything looks fine physically. I even reconnected all the cables. Still red light.
Understood. Let me escalate this to our technical team for a line check.
I work from home. I really need this fixed urgently. I've already spent 30 minutes troubleshooting.

extracted_facts: internet down since returning from 2-week trip

messages.content: I was charged ₹150 for a data pack I didn't buy. I want this reversed.
Hello Rahul. Let me check your account. I can see a Weekly Pack purchase on 2 September at 11:23 PM through the MyAccount app.
That wasn't me. I was asleep at 11 PM.
The purchase was made from the app. Is it possible someone else had access to your phone or account?
No. I live alone. My phone is always with me.

extracted_facts: system shows purchase at 11:23 PM on 2 Sep via app
customer claims no unauthorized access to phone

messages.content: Hi, I need a replacement SIM. My current SIM is not working.
Hello Suresh. I can help with that. Let me check your account. I can see your SIM was replaced about 45 days ago.
Yes, that one seems to have stopped working too.
I understand. Per our policy, a second SIM replacement within 90 days has a fee of ₹99. Would you like to proceed?
Why do I have to pay? It's not my fault the SIM stopped working.

extracted_facts: second SIM replacement request within 90 days
cause of second SIM failure unclear

messages.content: I cancelled my account in July and I'm still getting billed. This is absolutely unacceptable.
I'm very sorry to hear this, Mr. Bose. Let me pull up your account immediately.
I called in and cancelled in early July. I have a reference number. The agent confirmed it was cancelled.
Let me check. Your account currently shows as Active in our system. I do not see a cancellation record.
That's your problem. I want refunds for July, August, and September. That's ₹4,497 you've wrongly charged me.
I completely understand your frustration. This requires urgent investigation as I cannot see the cancellation record. Let me escalate this immediately.

extracted_facts: customer claims account cancelled in July 2024
customer has a reference number from cancellation call
account shows as Active in system
